HOW IT WORKS

How to organize
PDF pages.

01

Open your PDF.

Choose a file from your device. It opens right here in your browser.

02

Drag pages in the page strip or use the Move buttons. Select pages to rotate or remove them.

03

Download.

Save the whole document, or only the selected pages as a new PDF.

GOOD TO KNOW

Questions, answered.

Can I extract pages into a new PDF?

Yes. Select the pages, or type a range such as 1-3, 5, and choose Download selected pages.

Can I reorder pages without dragging?

Yes. Move earlier and Move later buttons work with the keyboard and on touch screens.

Can I combine pages from several PDFs?

Yes. Use Add PDF to bring in more files and arrange all the pages together, or start with Merge PDF.

Is my PDF uploaded?

No. Pages are rearranged in your browser and the file never leaves your device.
